full_judgment: 12. The facts of the case reported in 46 DLR 226 are that plaintiffs filed suit seeking partition of land of plot No.8II total area more or less 50 decimals. Plaintiffs claimed 25 decimals by purchase in 1979 as well as on the basis of lease from Vested Property Authority. The defendant Nos.1 and 2 claimed 18 decimals by purchase in 1976 out of 50 decimals of land of plot No.811. The plaintiffs prayed for injunction for restraining the defendants from making pucca construction till disposal of suit. The facts of the case reported in 1986 BLD 326 was that plaintiff filed the suit for partition of ejmali land. The plaintiff filed an application with the prayer for injunction to restrain defendant No.1 from making construction on the land in suit till disposal of the suit on the allegation primarily that construction the defendant allegedly intended to make would block plaintiffs 'passage' to and from his land. The plaintiff, in the case reported in 3 BLC (AD) 78 filed suit for declaration of title to and recovery of khas possession of the land in suit. Therein plaintiff prayed for injunction to restrain the defendants from making construction.
